title: Ending an Ostomy Supply Program Enrollment
content:
Only the customer can end an active Ostomy Supply Program enrollment. Larkfield records the cancellation as a program cancellation request, and the program closes only when the customer personally confirms that request.

**Closure reason.** A confirmed cancellation closes the program as customer discontinued, or as changed supplier when the customer states they are moving these supplies to another supplier. A cancellation of a program on hold is closed under the program's hold and closure rules.

**What ending a program does not change.**
- Ending a program carries no fee and cancels nothing the customer already owes: the balance stays payable.
- Credit balances are still refunded under the program's patient account rules.
- Unopened items delivered within the return window stay returnable under the program's return conditions.
- A package already shipped is not recalled.

**What lapses.** Authorized units remaining on a closed program lapse and are never shipped; a later restart needs a new referral and a new program.

| Situation (hypothetical) | Result |
|---|---|
| Cancellation request recorded, customer has not confirmed it | The program stays open |
| Customer confirms, says they are moving supplies to another supplier | Closed as changed supplier |
| Customer confirms, no change of supplier stated | Closed as customer discontinued |
